Context: 5. Reinstatement

3. (b) When under suspension pending departmental proceedings, on the withdrawal of proceedings for any reason, or on the award of penalty other than compulsory retirement/ removal I dismissal.
4. (c) When under suspension pending criminal proceedings, if acquitted by a Court of Law and if it is decided not to proceed further departmentally.
5. (d) On the setting aside of an award of compulsory retirement/ removal/ dismissal by a Court of Law or by the Appellate/Revising Authority.
